notes: Entries: one per species, numbered from 1 in each regional Pokédex; form Galarian marks entries whose picture on Serebii’s list is the Galarian form (the in-game Pokédex keeps every form inside the one entry). PokeAPI and Serebii agree on all three lists (400, 211, 210). Isle of Armor #211 Zarude is not needed to complete it (210). shieldOnly/swordOnly: Serebii’s Version Exclusives (47 rows each: 45 species and 2 forms, plus Gigantamax raids), with forms from Serebii’s Pokémon pages and in-game trades, and the 8 Dynamax Adventure legendaries each side. kind is species, form, gigantamax or dynamax-adventure; dexes lists the regional Pokédexes the species is in (empty = none). shinyLocked: encounters that can never be shiny, with shinyOtherwise saying whether a shiny can still be had another way (inferred where marked). Dynamax Adventure legendaries and Ultra Beasts are not shiny-locked (1 in 300, 1 in 100 with the Shiny Charm, Serebii); Regirock, Regice, Registeel, Regieleki, Regidrago, Cobalion, Terrakion and Virizion are not shiny-locked (rotomlabs). Regigigas: unsure.
